iEEGReference: Scalp reference ('Data were recorded with respect to a scalp reference.', imagery_basic README (SDR zk881ps0522))

Bandpass.Description: Built-in amplifier band pass 0.15 to 200 Hz, 1-pole, so no sharp corner at 200 Hz; amplitude roll-off function in ns_1k_1_300_filt.mat (imagery_basic README (SDR zk881ps0522)).

TaskDescription: Cue-based hand and tongue movement (acq-motth) and kinesthetic motor imagery of the same movements (acq-imth): repetitive self-paced movements (~1-2 Hz) of hand (clench/release fist) or tongue (protrude/retract), contralateral to the grid, in 2 s or 3 s cue blocks alternating with rest blocks of the same length (blank screen); 30-75 cues per modality; visual cues presented with BCI2000 as a written word in a 10 x 10 cm window at 75-100 cm. (imagery_basic README; Miller et al. 2010 PNAS doi:10.1073/pnas.0913697107)
Instructions: Imagery runs (acq-imth): 'imagine yourself performing the actions like you just did' - kinesthetic, not visual, imagery (imagery_basic README).
iEEGPlacementScheme: Subdural ECoG electrodes; grid location per source patient table kjm_ECoGLibrary_PatientTaskTable.pdf: R Frontal
